// Generated from qualified SeparateSetRemoveV1. DO NOT EDIT.
use super::validation_value::{ValidationError,Value};
use std::collections::HashSet;

#[derive(Debug,Clone,Copy)]
pub enum SyncDataType<'a>{Patch,Snapshot,Local,Other(&'a str)}
#[derive(Debug,Clone,Copy)]
pub struct BatchMutation<'a>{pub index:&'a str,pub operation:i32,pub binary_sync_data:&'a [u8],pub key_id:&'a [u8]}
/// These dependencies produce diagnostics only. Snapshot inspection may decode
/// payloads and fail; its error must propagate at the original call position.
pub trait BatchEffects{
 fn duplicate(&mut self,mutation:&BatchMutation<'_>);
 fn report(&mut self,metric:&'static str,is_fatal:bool);
 fn inspect_all(&mut self,mutations:&[BatchMutation<'_>])->Result<(),ValidationError>;
 fn local_warning(&mut self);
}
pub fn validate_no_duplicate_patch_version(versions:impl IntoIterator<Item=u64>)->Result<(),ValidationError>{
 let mut seen=HashSet::new();
 for version in versions{
  if !seen.insert(version){return Err(ValidationError::fatal(Value::Text("DUPLICATE_PATCH_VERSION_IN_COLLECTION".into()),"duplicate patch version in collection"));}
 }
 Ok(())
}
pub fn validate_no_same_index(mutations:&[BatchMutation<'_>],kind:SyncDataType<'_>,effects:&mut impl BatchEffects)->Result<(),ValidationError>{
 let mut sets=HashSet::new();let mut removes=HashSet::new();
 for mutation in mutations{
  let duplicate=match mutation.operation{@SET@=>!sets.insert(mutation.index),@REMOVE@=>!removes.insert(mutation.index),_=>false};
  if !duplicate{continue;}
  effects.duplicate(mutation);
  match kind{
   SyncDataType::Patch=>{
    effects.report("SAME_INDEX_FOR_MULTIPLE_MUTATIONS_IN_PATCH",true);
    return Err(ValidationError::fatal(Value::Text("SAME_INDEX_FOR_MULTIPLE_MUTATIONS_IN_PATCH".into()),"same index for multiple mutations in patch"));
   },
   SyncDataType::Snapshot=>{
    effects.report("SAME_INDEX_FOR_MULTIPLE_MUTATIONS_IN_SNAPSHOT",false);
    effects.inspect_all(mutations)?;
   },
   SyncDataType::Local=>effects.local_warning(),
   SyncDataType::Other(value)=>return Err(ValidationError::dependency("Error",&format!("Match: No case succesfully matched. Make exhaustive or add a wildcard case using '_'. Argument: {value}"))),
  }
 }
 Ok(())
}
